episode_row: lineup-status cell blank while the picked team fielded

commits.subject: fix(scorecard): compute lineup_status when picked team is fielding
commits.body:
Bug: when the picked batter's team is currently in the field (e.g.
Yoshida just made the 3rd out and BAL is now batting bottom 5), the
linescore's current_batter is on the opponent. The old logic looked
that ID up in the picked team's players dict, didn't find them, and
fell back to pre_game → blank cell on the dashboard.

Fix: when current_batter is on the opponent, switch the reference for
distance computation to the picked team's 'next leadoff' — the player
in the slot AFTER the picked team's last batter (mod 9). Yoshida (slot 3)
just batted → next BOS leadoff = slot 4 → distance = (3-4) % 9 = 8 →
renders '8 batters away'.

New helper: _next_leadoff_id_for_team(team, last_team_batter_id).
Falls back to slot 1 leadoff when team hasn't batted yet. Correctly
finds substitutes at the target slot via the current battingOrder array.

extract_batter_pas walks allPlays in reverse once to track the most-
recent batter per side; the per-batter loop picks current_batter or
next-leadoff as the reference based on whether picked team is batting.

5 new tests (4 helper + 1 integration); full suite 655 passing.
